description: Change how the bot looks. In one server (the default): its nickname, avatar, banner, and bio there, shown only in that server, so one bot can look different in each community. Everywhere (scope everywhere): its username, avatar, and banner, for every server it is in. Images come from public URLs; none removes a server-only one, so the global one shows again. A replaced avatar or banner is saved to the data folder first, since Discord does not keep it. Discord limits username changes to about two an hour.

avatar_url.description: Public URL of the avatar image (png, jpeg, gif, webp), or none.

banner_url.description: Public URL of the profile banner image, or none.

bio.description: Server only: the About Me shown in that server, or none. The bot's own About Me is set in the Developer Portal.

bot.description: Which bot to act as, by name, when more than one is configured. Omit to use the default bot, or with a server, the bot that handles it.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

nickname.description: Server only: the name shown in that server, or none to show the username.

scope.description: server (default) changes it in one server only; everywhere changes the bot's own profile.

name: update_bot_profile
title: Update bot profile
